run_recover_unannotated_scenes: run the script with --batch_id to recover unannotated scenes from a HITL annotation batch
run_main_filter_scenes: run main with a batch_id to filter annotated scenes into clean and unannotated lists
run_s3_upload_scene_lists: run the script to upload clean and unannotated scene JSON files to the droidlet-hitl S3 bucket
review_main_batch_processing: review the main function that processes a batch_id and separates scenes by annotation validity
refactor_main_shape_filtering: refactor main to use a different criteria than SHAPE_NAMES for filtering unannotated scenes
